profile.name: Frances Nunziata
profile.bio: Frances Nunziata has represented York South-Weston on Toronto City Council since 1997, making her the longest-serving member of council. Before amalgamation she was elected a City of York school board trustee in 1985, a York city councillor in 1988, and Mayor of York from 1994 to 1997. She has been elected Speaker of Toronto City Council by her colleagues since December 2010.
committees: George Bell Arena Board of Management

promises.text: Make street safety in York South-Weston her number one priority, including tackling road congestion, working with Toronto Police, speaking out about gun violence, pushing for better parks and community spaces, and cleaner streets.

Champion youth priorities: continue work on the Mayor's Youth Safety Task Force, host youth job fairs, and advocate for free, accessible youth-focused recreational space and programs in York South-Weston.

expensesDetailSource.name: Council Expense Routine Disclosure — Constituency Services & Office Expenses
expensesDetailSource.publisher: City Clerk's Office, City of Toronto
expensesDetailSource.note: Figures are the City's routine disclosure of constituency services and office expenses, shown as published, by category, from 2013. This is a separate publication from the annual remuneration reports in expenses.json, with a narrower scope — office spending only, not pay, benefits or staff salaries — and the two are never added together. Amounts shown as personal funds are the member's own money, as the City reports it. Invoice-level documents stay on the City's site; category amounts link to them.
